race.comment: ELITE INTENTION (3) is looking to continue his winning ways off a blistering 21.97 success at Ballarat. Rates a top chance again if runs up to latest. BAROOGA KING (2) jumped from the same box last time when scoring a Mix 3/4 win (23.32) at Horsham over 410m. Must include in calculations. MASTER WOODS (7) is worth forgiving for his last effort when fourth (22.43) at this track over 390m. Has a strong winning record at this journey. Strong form has emerged from his last run. Cannot be left out. MY NAME'S EDEN (8) justified the favourite's tag last time and another big run is on the cards.
